## Regular meetings

The Lower Murray Radio Club meets at **7:00 p.m. on the second and fourth Wednesdays** of each month.

**Where:** Combined Clubs, Johnstone Park, 12 Thomas Street, Murray Bridge.

Anyone interested in radio communications is welcome.

::: {#calendar}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
function pad(n) {
  return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
}

function ymd(d) {
  return d.getFullYear() + "-" + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + pad(d.getDate());
}

function secondAndFourthWednesdays(fromYear, toYear) {
  const meetings = [];
  const place = "Combined Clubs, Johnstone Park, 12 Thomas Street, Murray Bridge";

  for (let year = fromYear; year <= toYear; year++) {
    for (let month = 0; month < 12; month++) {
      const wednesdays = [];
      const day = new Date(year, month, 1);
      while (day.getMonth() === month) {
        if (day.getDay() === 3) {
          wednesdays.push(new Date(day.getFullYear(), day.getMonth(), day.getDate()));
        }
        day.setDate(day.getDate() + 1);
      }

      [1, 3].forEach(function (index) {
        if (!wednesdays[index]) return;
        const date = ymd(wednesdays[index]);
        meetings.push({
          title: "Club meeting",
          start: date + "T19:00:00",
          end: date + "T21:00:00",
          extendedProps: {
            place: place,
            when: date + " 7:00 p.m. Adelaide"
          }
        });
      });
    }
  }
  return meetings;
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const el = document.getElementById("calendar");
  if (!el || typeof FullCalendar === "undefined") return;

  const calendar = new FullCalendar.Calendar(el, {
    initialView: "listMonth",
    timeZone: "Australia/Adelaide",
    height: "auto",
    firstDay: 1,
    headerToolbar: {
      left: "prev,next today",
      center: "title",
      right: "dayGridMonth,listMonth"
    },
    eventTimeFormat: {
      hour: "numeric",
      minute: "2-digit",
      meridiem: "short"
    },
    events: function (info, successCallback, failureCallback) {
      const recurring = secondAndFourthWednesdays(2026, 2035);
      fetch("events.json")
        .then(function (response) {
          return response.ok ? response.json() : [];
        })
        .then(function (extra) {
          successCallback(recurring.concat(Array.isArray(extra) ? extra : []));
        })
        .catch(function () {
          successCallback(recurring);
        });
    },
    eventClick: function (info) {
      info.jsEvent.preventDefault();
      const extra = info.event.extendedProps || {};
      const place = extra.place || "Johnstone Park, Murray Bridge";
      const when = extra.when || (info.event.startStr || "").replace("T", " ").replace(/[+-]\d\d:\d\d$/, "").replace("Z", "");
      alert(info.event.title + "\n" + when + "\n" + place);
    }
  });
  calendar.render();
});
</script>
